unit: Harvard-MIT Program in Health Sciences and Technology (HST)
notes: HST is a joint Harvard-MIT graduate program, not itself a department with independent labs -- its 'Faculty & Research > Faculty' link (https://hst.harvard.edu/faculty-research/faculty) resolves to the homepage's content with no faculty roster, both via plain fetch and Playwright render (possibly a broken/renamed route). HST-affiliated faculty are typically MIT or HMS PIs already counted in their home department's own source file. Recommend status 'partial' -- the real faculty-listing URL needs to be found (e.g. via hst.mit.edu, the MIT-side mirror, in a later pass).
